main.description: Placeholder main def; the three concrete space types are below. Proposal 0016 declares one space type per lexicon, so at implementation time these split into app.flowstate.space.personal / .group / .inbox.
main.title: Flow State

personal.title: Flow State (personal)
personal.description: One per user, authority = the user's own DID. Holds their flow instances (minus secrets), day-plan blocks and event history so every device they sign into has the same setup. Replaces manual vault export/import for signed-in users. app.flowstate.block (day-plan block) and app.flowstate.device (registered device + push capability) are not yet defined.

group.title: Flow State group
group.description: One per group (household, team). Members share flows and emit events to each other. Authority is the creator's DID for v1; moves to a dedicated group DID once group hosts exist.

inbox.title: Flow inbox
inbox.description: One per flow that accepts outside events. Authority = flow owner. Writers are the specific DIDs (people, bots, services) allowed to trigger that one flow; revoking one writer affects nothing else.
